milestone: Second Supabase 57014 — drainPendingSync() In-Flight Race Fix
slice: A real, confirmed client-side race found chasing a live Postgres 57014 (statement timeout) report on builder_projects, genuinely separate from the earlier RLS-subquery indexing fix (this table's own policies are plain owner_id checks, no correlated subqueries at all). Root cause: drainPendingSync() -- the retry-forever cloud-sync loop -- has four independent triggers (boot, the browser's online event, a 60s interval, and a 2s debounce fired from every edit) with zero coordination between them; two firing close together started overlapping drain cycles, each deciding the SAME pending record was due and both calling _attemptSync(id) concurrently -- two DB transactions racing to UPDATE the exact same row, the second blocking on the first's row lock until it commits; any real-world hiccup holding the first transaction open turned that ordinary sub-millisecond wait into a genuine, repeating statement-timeout, matching both the reported 21-second duration (queued behind a stuck lock) and the empty response body (a severed connection, not a normal PostgREST error). Fixed with an in-flight guard (_drainInFlightPromise, set synchronously before any await so even two calls in the same tick correctly de-duplicate) -- the identical fix landed in js/creatorProjectCache.js (Studio's sibling module) too, kept in lockstep as always. Verified via a dedicated Playwright reproduction (a real test-mock bug -- a delayed fake network .then() that never returned a real Promise, silently defeating the artificial delay -- was found and fixed before the real fix could be properly proven): two synchronous calls return the exact same promise; three overlapping triggers within a slowed fake network window produce exactly ONE real DB call, not two; the record still settles correctly; a later project drains on its own fresh cycle; two records pending at once both still push exactly once each. Full regression across every existing Cloud-Primary Project Storage Playwright suite (Phase 1-6, both surfaces) and both goldenBuild.js suites passes unchanged. See CLAUDE.md's own entry for the full account.
